## Problem and result

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue
or public specification when available.

## Verification

List the commands and results, exact artifact evidence where applicable, and
any checks not run with a reason. For documentation/configuration changes,
describe the corresponding format, link, and configuration checks.

## Risks and limits

Describe compatibility, size, browser, security, or evidence limits that matter
to this change. Do not treat a successful build as release approval.

## Checklist

- [ ] Read `AGENTS.md` and the relevant public documentation.
- [ ] Preserve unrelated changes and untouched Markdown/frontmatter.
- [ ] Add meaningful behavior tests or explain why focused non-test checks suffice.
- [ ] Update affected public documentation; keep private working notes in the ignored `.local-archive/`.
- [ ] Use synthetic evidence; include no real documents, recovery data, credentials, or private keys.
